evidence.quote: Pure Cr, Co, Ni and V (99.9 %, mass fraction) were melted to produce (CrCoNi)96V4 MEA ingot with equal atomic ratio at the atmosphere of pure argon by arc melting technology. In order to ensure the uniformity of chemical composition and microstructure, the alloy was melted four times and then cooled to room temperature to get button ingot.
The alloy was deformed by three passes of rolling at room temperature (RTR), and the total deformation was 67 %.
After that, recrystallized annealing was carried out at the temperature of 700 ◦C, 800 ◦C and 900 ◦C separately, with a annealing time of 30 min.
